policy.representative_view_goal: Show the muscle in the view that best explains belly, course, origin/insertion relationship and key bony landmarks.
reject_as_representative: view where the target muscle is poorly exposed
view chosen only because an image exists
cropped or layered view that obscures the main course without a specific educational reason
policy.secondary_assets: Only when a second view adds distinct educational value.
policy.license_requirement: Source page, author and reuse license must be explicit for fixed media.
